llm_response.reason: The website offers an unusually broad and eclectic set of products (luxury, hobby, electronics, tickets) at unrealistic discounts, uses urgency tactics, and claims 'all shipping is free'—all common features of scam shops. The contact email is a generic non-corporate address (rieiko@darde.info), and no real company named '鈴木 真由美販売店' can be found in reputable directories or search results. The site mimics a large-scale Japanese shopping site, but lacks verifiable company information, and the privacy polices and business details are generic and ambiguous. These are clear indicators of a fake online shopping scam.
